messages.subject: Complimentary zig zag design
parts: Hi, Does Distance for Windows allow for a survey design using complimentary equal spaced zig zag lines? My survey area has multiple strata and each day a different strata will be surveyed. The survey day begins and ends at the same place each day. I've found the option in the dssd package in R for "eszigzagcom,"  but wondering if there is a way to do this in the windows interface?

messages.author: 875f0a74e1b42050
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Complimentary zig zag design
parts:
Dear Julia,

The complementary zigzag design is only available in the dssd R package not in Distance for Windows.
Was there some reason you didn't want to use R - happy to offer some assistance?

In Distance for Windows the option we used to do when we wanted a complementary zigzag design was to just generate two sets of zigzags but as they both have to be selected at random it may be that you end up almost covering the same lines again just by chance. Alternatively, you can generate one set and look to manually create the set of complement zigzag lines. 

Best wishes,
Laura
